A '''blood scanner''' was a [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] used to analyze [[Blood/Legends|blood]]. Utilized for medical diagnostics, the device could assess the well-being of an individual, able to scan the blood of nearly any [[Species/Legends|species]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Blood scanners specialized in the isolation and identification of agents foreign to the bloodstream, including toxins such as chemicals, [[Poison/Legends|poisons]], and [[Disease/Legends|diseases]]. The scanner provided extensive information about a patient's health and offered medical advice once an agent had been identified, suggesting antidotes, remedies, and other effective options for treatment. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], blood scanners cost 400 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="KtP" />

==Behind the scenes==
The blood scanner was first mentioned in ''[[Keeping the Peace]]'', a sourcebook for the ''[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny]]'' [[roleplaying game]] line, published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] on [[December 17]], [[2015]].<ref name="KtP" />
